english.note: Use 練習 as the all-purpose verb for practising an ability or skill.
Use this for practising or training a skill, person, animal, or mental ability.

examples.english: I train by swimming every day.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 lin6 zaap6 jau4 seoi2

examples.english: They exercise their Cantonese every day.
examples.traditional: 佢哋每日都練習廣東話。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 mui5 jat6 dou1 lin6 zaap6 gwong2 dung1 waa2
